adopt.description: Adopt writes lock entries for existing unmanaged project-scope installs

allow_unsigned.description:
AllowUnsigned permits recording a plugin as unsigned in the lock file,
in two cases: adopting an install whose signature state cannot be
established (see Adopt), and repairing an entry that records no trust
decision at all, whose reinstall otherwise fails closed on unsigned
content.

check.description: Check verifies on-disk content against the lock file without installing or writing anything

clients.description:
Clients lists target client identifiers. Empty means every
plugin-supporting client detected on this host.

project_root.description: ProjectRoot is the project root path whose lock file should be synced

prune.description: Prune removes project-scoped plugins installed but not present in the lock file

public_key.description: PublicKey supplies the cosign public key for key-signed adoption.
